ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, x(t) is a two-level rectangular waveform even-symmetric about t=0. The signal is 0 when t<-2 and t>2; in the intervals -2 to -1, and 1 to 2, the height is 1; in the interval -1 to 1, the height is 2. The dashed line marks height 1, and the top platform height is 2. Reasoning: This waveform can be decomposed into the sum of two centered rectangular pulses: one rectangular pulse with height 1 and range [-2,2], plus one rectangular pulse with height 1 and range [-1,1]. Using the Fourier transform definition X(ω)=∫ x(t)e^(-jωt)dt, and Sa(u)=sin(u)/u. For a centered rectangular pulse with height 1 and range [-T,T], its Fourier transform is ∫_{-T}^{T} e^(-jωt)dt = 2sin(ωT)/ω = 2T Sa(ωT). Therefore, the [-2,2] pulse gives 4Sa(2ω), and the [-1,1] pulse gives 2Sa(ω). By linear superposition, X(ω)=4Sa(2ω)+2Sa(ω)=2Sa(ω)+4Sa(2ω).

method.method_draft: First describe the image as a two-level even rectangular waveform: base level 1 from -2 to 2 and an added level 1 from -1 to 1. Write x(t)=rect-like pulse on [-2,2] + rect-like pulse on [-1,1]. Apply the centered rectangle Fourier transform formula to each component and sum the results by linearity, yielding X(ω)=4Sa(2ω)+2Sa(ω), i.e. 2Sa(ω)+4Sa(2ω).

推理：该波形可分解为两个居中的矩形脉冲相加：一个高度为 1、范围为 [-2,2] 的矩形脉冲，加上一个高度为 1、范围为 [-1,1] 的矩形脉冲。采用傅里叶变换定义 X(ω)=∫ x(t)e^(-jωt)dt，且 Sa(u)=sin(u)/u。对于高度为 1、范围为 [-T,T] 的居中矩形脉冲，其傅里叶变换为 ∫_{-T}^{T} e^(-jωt)dt = 2sin(ωT)/ω = 2T Sa(ωT)。因此，[-2,2] 脉冲给出 4Sa(2ω)，[-1,1] 脉冲给出 2Sa(ω)。由线性叠加，X(ω)=4Sa(2ω)+2Sa(ω)=2Sa(ω)+4Sa(2ω)。

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：波形关于纵轴对称，中心区间 [-1,1] 高度为 2，两侧区间 [-2,-1] 和 [1,2] 高度为 1，其他为 0。Then form the CTFT integral using evenness: X(ω)=2(2∫_0^1 cosωt dt+∫_1^2 cosωt dt). Evaluate the elementary sine terms and rewrite them in Sa notation to arrive at X(ω)=2Sa(ω)+4Sa(2ω).
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中连续时间信号 x(t) 是关于纵轴 t=0 对称的阶梯矩形波。由图可见，在中心区间 -1 \le t \le 1 内幅度为 2；在两侧区间 -2 \le t < -1 和 1 < t \le 2 内幅度为 1；在 |t|>2 时幅度为 0。\n\n再推理：采用连续时间傅里叶变换定义 X(\omega)=\int_{-\infty}^{\infty}x(t)e^{-j\omega t}dt。因为 x(t) 为偶函数，所以虚部积分为 0，可写为 X(\omega)=2\int_0^{\infty}x(t)\cos(\omega t)dt。根据图中的分段幅度，X(\omega)=2\left(2\int_0^1\cos(\omega t)dt+\int_1^2\cos(\omega t)dt\right)。计算得 \int_0^1\cos(\omega t)dt=\sin\omega/\omega，\int_1^2\cos(\omega t)dt=(\sin2\omega-\sin\omega)/\omega。因此 X(\omega)=2\left(2\frac{\sin\omega}{\omega}+\frac{\sin2\omega-\sin\omega}{\omega}\right)=2\frac{\sin\omega}{\omega}+2\frac{\sin2\omega}{\omega}。若 Sa(u)=\sin u/u，则 2\frac{\sin\omega}{\omega}=2Sa(\omega)，且 2\frac{\sin2\omega}{\omega}=4Sa(2\omega)。所以 X(\omega)=2Sa(\omega)+4Sa(2\omega)。
